title: Settlement payouts, STK fixes, and clearer client status
items: Settlement payout method: choose phone number, till/paybill, or bank (dropdown, paybill, account number) — not phone-only.
Fixed staff-initiated STK push failing with "invalid phone number" or "gateway not configured" for platform-collected tenants.
SMS broadcasts, bulk messages, and outage alerts now send once per customer, not once per PPPoE line.
Clients list: Plan/Router/Expiry moved under each account's Services tab; Status now shows Online, last seen, or Blocked.
Payout failures are now logged server-side instead of only showing in the browser.

title: Fixed the settlement payout method dropdown showing blank
items: Settings → Payment gateways: the payout method and bank dropdowns now actually list their options.

title: Clients list rearranged: A/C no, name, wallet, email, service, phone, registered, status
items: Columns reordered to A/C No, Client name, Wallet, Email, Service, Phone, Registered, Status.
Row actions are now a single "Actions ▾" dropdown: View, Services, Edit client, Delete client.

title: Expenses with suppliers, monthly bills and profit & loss; clearer client status
items: Expenses: monthly bills that add themselves to the log before they are due, suppliers with payment details, and paid payroll recorded automatically.
New Profit & loss tab: PPPoE and hotspot income against paid expenses, month by month.
Clients: the package name, a coloured online/offline dot and days left. Clients blocked for 4 months become dormant, and are deleted after 5.
Settings → Message templates, staff ID badges with expiry, and staff password reset.

title: Licence & billing: pay by M-Pesa prompt or paybill; payouts in full on your schedule
items: New Licence & billing page: see what is owed, pay with an M-Pesa prompt to your own phone, or pay to the paybill with your reference.
If a licence expires, only the dashboard becomes view-only — customers and hotspot visitors are never affected.
Payouts are paid in full (no commission deducted), daily, weekly or manual — choose under Settings → Gateways.
Platform fees are billed monthly instead: 3% of hotspot sales plus KES 16 per active PPPoE client.
The free trial is 14 days and is never invoiced.
An expired licence now opens a dedicated page with the ways to pay. Payouts pause until it is renewed and are released afterwards.
After the 14-day free trial, KES 500 activates your licence for 30 days — pay by M-Pesa prompt or paybill.
An expired licence now locks the dashboard completely — only the licence and payment page opens. Customers and hotspot visitors are never affected.
Tenants who host for themselves can be billed a flat monthly fee, and their server shows the licence-expired page if it lapses.

title: Invoice links, SaaS revenue overview, smarter leads
items: SaaS revenue: recurring revenue, collection rate, churn, next-month forecast and who owes what.
Tenants can be billed by revenue share or a flat tier; licence days are added on top of what is left, and spare credit turns into licence months.
Payout & pay-in history now shows SMS credit sales and each tenant's collected, settled and remaining balance.
Invoices: download a PDF, and share a link a customer can open and pay from with an M-Pesa prompt — no login needed.
Leads: filter by stage, installer and channel; assign an installer to many at once; add the package they asked about; see why leads are lost; new Insights tab.
A lead's referrer (the channel) earns the commission and the sales credit; "Installer" is the technician who follows up the installation.
Staff: a Reset password button that sends the new password by SMS and email.
Popups, toasts and update notices now open on the screen in dark mode instead of far down the page.
Payment gateways: the platform paybill can now be saved even when the owner's own ISP portal uses the same paybill number.
Site payment profiles: choose per site whether customers pay through the platform (settled to you) or your own paybill, so one ISP can use both.
Tickets: the list now shows the client on every ticket (name, account and location), and marks installations.
Leads: a won lead has a Raise installation ticket button, and adding the client from a won lead goes straight to the ticket with the client and installer already chosen.
Referral commission is now a percentage of the service package the client signed up for, not of the money their first payment happened to be.
Installation fee: set a standard fee under Settings → Preferences; adding a client charges it as an invoice, and you can change it or waive it for any one client.

Declaring a lead won now raises the installation ticket automatically (assigned to the lead's installer, with who to call and what they bought); adding the client from the lead attaches them to that ticket.
Sales leaderboard now counts the service package fee only — installation fees, top-ups and months paid ahead no longer inflate a salesperson's figure (Leads → Performance and Employee of the Month).
Payments → All transactions shows the voucher code issued for hotspot (KopoKopo) payments, and the phone number the prompt was sent to.
Licence & billing: the amount box is pre-filled with what you owe, or, when nothing is invoiced yet, what this month's statement stands at so far.
Monthly tenant statements are now raised on the last day of the month (23:55), instead of the 1st of the next month.
Each monthly statement now shows when it is due: by default the 5th of the next month at 10:00 AM (Licence & billing → Pay by).
No more free trial: a new tenant is free until the 5th of the next month at 10:00 AM (sign up on the 1st: about five weeks; on the 21st: about two), then pays each month by the 5th.
A statement unpaid by its due time (the 5th, 10:00 AM) now locks the licence until it is paid.
The licence counter in the top bar counts down to the exact lock time (days and hours, then hours and minutes).
A named TV, console or device keeps its reserved IP for a week after its plan expires, so it reconnects on the same address when it pays again; the IP is given back after 7 days.
Fixed expiry reminders, one-off SMS and bulk SMS naming the tenant's own paybill for customers on a router set to collect through the platform; the {paybill} tag now follows the customer's router.
Site payment profiles can now be viewed and edited, not just added or deleted.
A client with a due, unpaid invoice now shows a negative balance (-KES) in the client list and on their account.

Clients table: a new Invoices action, and each client's Invoices page, let you create, view, edit and delete invoices. New invoices are itemised (description, quantity, price) with quick-add lines for installation, package, router and reconnection, payment terms (due now, 3, 7, 14, 30 days or a date) and the tax worked out in the total.
When a client pays, what they already owe (installation fee and other due invoices) is cleared first, oldest first; only the rest buys service or goes to the wallet.
Hotspot plans: a name like "2 devices" must match the Devices field, and changing a plan's device count now updates the routers and the codes already sold, so a second device can connect.
Client → Live data now shows how long the customer has been online this session and how much they have downloaded and uploaded in that time.
Routers → System info shows the data the router has carried since it last started, and each client's PPPoE service shows how long it has been online and the data used in that session.

New: the field technician app (Field app in the menu, also installable on a phone): jobs, closing photos, customer look-up with their PPPoE login, shifts with an accurate location, equipment with serial photos and stock deduction, raising tickets and leads from the phone, working with no signal. Turn it on per role with "Use the technician app".
New: Field team shows where technicians are while they are on shift. Tickets have a job type (repair or install), and a ticket's photos and equipment show on it.
Leads: a lead logged from the field shows its pinned location with a View on map link.

Online but no internet: every 10 minutes the system checks online PPPoE lines; one that is connected, moving nothing and not answering a ping is flagged "Online · not answering" in the clients list (and has its own filter).
Client → Live data has a Diagnose button that checks the account, the router session, the router's own internet, the customer's device and the traffic, and says the likely cause in plain words.
Fixed: the online time and data used for a PPPoE service now show on the Services tab and the Live data tab (they were not being displayed). They are read straight from the router.
A Troubleshoot button on each PPPoE service (client → Services) and in the clients table menu: asks the router what is wrong with a line that is online but has no internet and says the likely cause.

Client → Statistics shows the exact data used each day, grouped by month for the last 12 months; click a month to see every day of it. Counting starts from this update, earlier figures are approximate.
Client → Communication now lists every SMS and email the customer has received, including the automatic ones (receipts, reminders, expiry notices), not just messages typed on the Messaging screen.

Settings → Organisation: choose the country (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Ghana, Nigeria, Zambia, South Africa and more) and the currency. Customers' phone numbers are now read and texted in that country's format instead of always as Kenyan numbers.

New payment methods outside Kenya: Flutterwave (Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Ghana, Zambia, Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal), Paystack (Ghana, Nigeria, South Africa), AzamPay (Tanzania) and Yo! Payments (Uganda). Add them under Settings → Payment gateways, pick one for the hotspot under Hotspot → Settings, and click Webhook URL to see what to paste into the provider's dashboard.
Hotspot pages show prices in the tenant's own currency, and a payment link when the provider needs one.
A cookie notice appears the first time someone opens the site: Accept all or Essential only, remembered for a year, and changeable from Cookie settings in the footer.

Dashboard → Top commission earner: "sales closed" now counts the clients whose first payment earned the commission, instead of showing 0 when the lead was never marked won. Adding a client from a lead now marks that lead won.
Leads: once a won lead's installation ticket is resolved, the Install ticket button becomes "✓ Installed" instead of staying as a call to raise it again.

New: Schedule. Book installations and repairs for a date, time and technician on a weekly calendar (or from a ticket's Schedule a visit button). The customer is texted the booking and a reminder a few hours before, the technician is texted where to go, double-booking a technician is flagged, and booked jobs show their time in the field app.
